plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Riverbed SteelHead WAN optimization device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 17163). It also reports optimized, passthrough, half-opened, half-closed, established, active and total connections, the connection limit, optimization service status, and optimization peers.
name: Wanopt

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute rolling CPU utilization of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuUtil1) as a 0-100 percentage aggregated across all CPUs. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate optimization-service overload or an admission-control condition.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load1
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute CPU load of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuLoad1). The raw OID is hundredths of load and is divided by 100 for display. This is not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load5
metrics.description: This metric reports the five-minute CPU load of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuLoad5). The raw OID is hundredths of load and is divided by 100 for display. This is not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load15
metrics.description: This metric reports the fifteen-minute CPU load of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuLoad15). The raw OID is hundredths of load and is divided by 100 for display. This is not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the SteelHead system temperature (STEELHEAD-MIB systemTemperature) in degrees Celsius. Sustained high temperature can indicate cooling failure or an overheated environment.

metrics.name: device_health_state
metrics.description: This metric reports SteelHead system health (STEELHEAD-MIB systemHealth). Raw codes healthy=10000, degraded=30000, admissionControl=31000 and critical=50000 are normalized to 1=healthy and 2=not-healthy. A value greater than 1 indicates degraded, admission-control or critical health.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: optimized_connections
metrics.description: Current number of optimized connections on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB optimizedConnections). Zero while traffic should be accelerated means optimization has stopped or all sessions fell back to passthrough.

metrics.name: passthrough_connections
metrics.description: Current number of passthrough connections on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB passthroughConnections). A sudden jump can mean the optimization service stopped or sessions were forced through unoptimized.

metrics.name: half_opened_connections
metrics.description: Current number of half-opened optimized connections on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB halfOpenedConnections). A count that stays above zero means session setup is stuck.

metrics.name: half_closed_connections
metrics.description: Current number of half-closed optimized connections on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB halfClosedConnections). A sustained rise can mean peers are not finishing connection teardown.

metrics.name: established_connections
metrics.description: Current number of established optimized connections on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB establishedConnections).

metrics.name: active_connections
metrics.description: Current number of active optimized connections on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB activeConnections).

metrics.name: total_connections
metrics.description: Total number of connections on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB totalConnections), covering optimized and passthrough sessions.

metrics.name: max_connections
metrics.description: Maximum number of connections this Riverbed SteelHead appliance can carry (STEELHEAD-MIB shMaxConnections). Compare with total and optimized connections to see remaining headroom.

metrics.name: opt_service_ok
metrics.description: Optimization service health. 1 means running. 2 means any other state, including none, unmanaged, pending, stopping, and stopped.

metrics.name: opt_service_status
metrics.description: Raw optimization service status on the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB optServiceStatus): none=0, unmanaged=1, running=2, sentCom1=3, sentTerm1=4, sentTerm2=5, sentTerm3=6, pending=7, stopped=8.

metrics.name: steelhead_peer
metrics.description: One series per Riverbed SteelHead optimization peer (STEELHEAD-MIB peerTable). The value is 1 when the peer row is present. Hostname, address, software version, and model are tags. A drop from one or more rows to none means every peer disappeared.

metrics.name: steelhead_peer_count
metrics.query: count(steelhead_peer_present{instance_type='wanopt', collect_type='snmp_riverbed', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) or sum(snmp_uptime{instance_type='wanopt', collect_type='snmp_riverbed', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) * 0
metrics.description: Number of Riverbed SteelHead optimization peer rows. When the peer table is empty the count falls back to 0 as long as the device is still reporting uptime, so a drop from one or more peers to none stays visible.
